description: 新竹市寬頻管道建置計劃資料 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 養護工程處. 本市95-98年寬頻管道建置計劃資料. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 養護工程處. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx, csv, xml, json. The portal shows 2026-08-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
